sources.title: ValorC3 October 26, 2026: current operations in St. George, Boise and Oklahoma City
sources.summary: The original October 26, 2026 release explicitly states that ValorC3 currently operates purpose-built carrier-neutral data centers in St. George, Boise and Oklahoma City, serving banks, healthcare systems and other enterprises. This supports operation of the existing commercial hosts identified by the individual facility pages. The SOC attestations are the release topic, not independently interpreted as proof of opening or commissioning.

extraction.date_semantics: Visible body dateline: BOISE, Idaho – Oct. 26, 2026. The separate present-tense operating statement is the selected physical-status basis. Neither CMS dateModified, retrieval nor audit completion is substituted for it.
extraction.status_scope: Existing BOI-1, STG-1 and OKC-1 commercial hosts. No opening date, operating MW, full utilization, entire future campus completion or BOI-2 operation is asserted.
extraction.successor_review: The original current newsroom lists the October 26 SOC release as its latest company announcement. The latest 20 full WordPress posts were also captured and reviewed, with newest November 2; those posts concern general infrastructure/services rather than a later closure or physical status change at these hosts. Targeted later-event searches and current individual location pages through November 11 did not identify a conflicting primary physical observation. This is a bounded review, not an exhaustive incident history.
extraction.historical_identity_context: The original rebrand release carries a January 20, 2025 body dateline and identifies ValorC3 as formerly Tonaquint. The original acquisition page joins EdgeX to the Oklahoma City platform; its current rendered body is undated, so no acquisition date is inferred from CMS metadata. These captures support alias review, not fresh observation dates.
extraction.boise_scope_conflict: The metro page says two data centers operate, but the individual BOI-2 page explicitly says coming soon and on track to open in 2027. Only the longstanding BOI-1 address is selected; BOI-2 is excluded. The September 1 operator social post additionally describes BOI-1 and its existing DC3 hall, without establishing consumption of its advertised available capacity.

The Census match normalizes away the W direction while retaining the exact number, Emerald Street, Boise and ZIP 83704.
extraction.identity_and_nearby_review: All four baseline identity layers were searched: 1,282 sites, 1,391 projects, both 231 records and 231 decisions in identity-mapping.json, and 231 original source records. No match was found for the combined ValorC3, Tonaquint, exact-address and former-brand aliases, including ValorC3, Valor C3, Tonaquint, Fiberpipe, BOI-1/BOI1 and 10215 Emerald. Distances to every complete existing site geometry were checked, including polygons; no existing host is within 2 km. The nearest is Meta Kuna, 14.196 km away. One existing BOI-1 host containing its DC2/DC3 halls. The separate BOI-2 building on Emerald Street is excluded; its stated 2027 opening remains future.

sources.title: Megaport: Fortaleza network services live at Ascenty and AngoNAP II
sources.license: source terms; compact factual projection only
sources.summary: Megaport reports live network service inside the named Angola Cables AngoNAP II host in Fortaleza. This supports existing commercial hosting, without establishing a new data-center opening, completed expansion or whole-campus capacity.

extraction.date_basis: Original Megaport-authored SocialMediaPosting explicitly gives datePublished 2026-10-05T18:54:03.738Z. Relative display ages, CMS/retrieval dates and secondary republication dates are not selected.
extraction.scope: The report separately names Ascenty Fortaleza and Angola Cables AngoNAP II as live network sites. Ascenty remains the separately admitted Maracanaú host; this change binds the existing canonical source to AngoNAP as well.
extraction.canonical_reuse: Same original URL, body hash and canonical metadata as the source already selected in snapshot 149; only a new project association is added.
extraction.later_status_review: Bounded searches for AngoNAP/Fortaleza later reports in Portuguese and English through November 11 found no later original closure, relocation or contradictory physical status. Current Angola Cables and TelCables facility/contact material still identifies the Fortaleza host. The Angola Cables news route returns an application shell and the TelCables news route returned 404, so neither is treated as an inspected complete news index. Historical expansion plans and network-capacity upgrades do not establish completion of a separate data-center phase or continuous availability.

extraction.address: Avenida Trajano de Medeiros, 1851, Praia do Futuro I, Fortaleza, Ceará, 60182-325
extraction.identity_scope: The office footer alone is not the facility join. The parent Angola Cables application contact record explicitly labels this same number as Data Center AngonaNAP Fortaleza; the city independently names its data-center event at number 1851.

sources.title: Fortaleza SEFIN cadastral parcel 31405: Avenida Trajano de Medeiros 1851
sources.license: public municipal cadastral service; attribution retained; no explicit open-content licence asserted
sources.attribution: Prefeitura de Fortaleza, SEFIN cadastral data via the municipal maps service
sources.summary: The city’s public WFS returns one cadastral parcel with the exact operator address, territorial ID 31405 and cartographic reference 52-41-100. A point is derived inside that parcel.

extraction.query_review: The exact address filter matched one record. A separate id=212756 query and a neighborhood query returned identical geometry and properties. Generated WFS feature-ID suffixes vary by request; stable properties id 212756, territorial 31405 and cartographic 52-41-100 identify the parcel.
extraction.source_route: The public municipal lot catalogue links to its map. Its normal anonymous getMap request identifies the SEFIN layer; the published map client uses /api/v1/ows. No restricted SEFIN endpoint, proxy credential or geolocation bypass was used.
extraction.upstream_metadata: The source attributes cite SIRGAS 2000 / UTM 24S (EPSG:31984), while returned GeoJSON explicitly declares EPSG:4326 and supplies longitude/latitude coordinates. Upstream transformation, realization and epoch are unspecified.
extraction.derivation: EPSG:4326 supplied GeoJSON projected mathematically to WGS84 UTM zone24S (EPSG:32724), area centroid then inverse to EPSG:4326; no local datum shift. Upstream SIRGAS 2000 conversion details/epoch unstated.
extraction.scope: Interior parcel centroid, not building footprint, entrance, leased room or complete expansion boundary. The parcel remains a source geometry; the Atlas selects only a Point. Decimal precision does not imply survey accuracy.
extraction.data_vintage: SEFIN 2023 layer; municipal catalogue created and updated January 4, 2024. Neither is a physical-status observation date.
